evals.prompt: Convert this script to a skill: scripts/new-skill.sh
evals.expected_output: A SKILL.md created at .apm/skills/kerpo-<appropriate-name>/ that captures the scaffold logic as agent instructions, plus evals/ scaffolding.
assertions: A new skill directory was created under .apm/skills/
The created SKILL.md has valid frontmatter with name, description, license, compatibility, metadata
The SKILL.md body contains agent-native instructions, not shell commands copied verbatim

evals.expected_output: The complex run-evals script is decomposed into multiple focused skills (e.g. kerpo-run-eval-case, kerpo-grade-eval, kerpo-aggregate-benchmark) with a proposed chain, not crammed into one large skill.
assertions: Multiple skills are proposed or created, not a single monolithic skill
Each skill has a clear single responsibility

evals.prompt: Turn this bash one-liner into a skill: find . -name '*.md' | xargs grep -l 'TODO'
evals.expected_output: Agent is guided to find TODO items in markdown files — not wrap the grep command, but describe the intent as an agent action.
assertions: The skill description uses agent-native language, not shell syntax
The skill is appropriately scoped (simple enough to be one skill)
